2. एव ind. This particle is most frequently used to strengthen
 and emphasize the idea expressed by a word:− (1) Just, quite, exactly;
 एवमेव quite so, just so; (2) same, very, identical; अर्थोष्मणा
 विरहितः पुरुषः स एव

that very man; (3) only, alone, merely,
 (implying exclusion); सा तथ्यमेवाभिहिता भवेन

only the
 truth, nothing but the truth; so नाम्नैव, स एव वीरः he alone (and
 not others); (4) already; गत एव न ते निवर्तते

; (5)
 scarcely, the moment, as soon as; chiefly with participles; उपस्थितेयं
 कल्याणी नाम्नि कीर्तित एव यत्
as soon as the name was uttered;

while just thinking &c.; (6) also, likewise; तथैव
 so also; (7) like, as (showing similarity); श्रीस्त एव मेस्तु G. M.
 (= तव इव); and (8) generally to emphasize a statement; भवितव्यमेव

 Sāyaṇa a desire or hymn.
